name: safety bar elevated heel squat
description: A safety bar squat with your heels raised on a small platform. The elevation lets your knees travel forward to target the quads.
instructions: Place plates or a wedge under your heels in front of the rack.
Unrack the safety bar and step onto the platform.
Keep your chest upright and brace your core.
Squat down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up and rack the bar when done.
